Serving Omaha Metro

Old water heaters, rusty chain-link fencing, a pile of pipes from a plumbing job, car parts that have been sitting in the garage since the Clinton administration — scrap metal accumulates in garages, basements, yards, and job sites all over the Omaha metro. A1 Junk Removal and Tree Service picks up scrap metal from homes and businesses across Bellevue, La Vista, and the greater Omaha area. We load it, haul it, and take it straight to a recycling facility where it gets processed properly instead of sitting in your yard rusting.

We're not a scrap yard — we're a junk removal service that handles metal along with everything else. The difference is that we come to you. You don't have to load a trailer, sort your metals, or wait in line at the recycler. We show up, grab the metal, and it's gone. The scrap value of the material helps offset your removal cost, which means metal-heavy loads are often cheaper than you'd expect.

Common Scrap Metal We Pick Up

Appliances and HVAC Equipment

Old water heaters, furnaces, AC units, washers, dryers, and refrigerators. These are heavy on steel and copper, which makes them prime recycling candidates.

Fencing and Structural Metal

Chain-link fencing, wrought iron, steel posts, metal gates, and rebar. We pull it up, cut it down, and load it on the truck.

Automotive Parts and Shop Scrap

Engines, transmissions, exhaust systems, rims, body panels, and miscellaneous shop metal. If you're cleaning out a garage or workshop, we'll take the metal pile.

Construction and Renovation Scrap

Pipes, ductwork, conduit, steel studs, metal roofing, and demolition debris. Contractors call us to clear metal from job sites so they can keep working.

Scrap metal and old exercise equipment removal — Omaha, NE

How Scrap Value Affects Your Price

Metal has real value at the recycler. Steel, aluminum, copper, and brass all have per-pound prices that fluctuate with the market. When your load is heavy on recyclable metal, the scrap value helps offset the cost of removal. That means a pile of old appliances or a stack of steel fencing is often cheaper to haul away than the same volume of mixed household junk. We factor the scrap value into your quote, so you're getting the benefit without having to sort, load, and drive to the scrap yard yourself. If you've also got old appliances mixed in with the scrap, we handle it all in one trip.

Job Site and Commercial Pickup

Contractors, property managers, and business owners across the Omaha metro call us to clear metal from renovation projects, demolition sites, and facility cleanouts. If you're tearing out old plumbing, replacing HVAC equipment, or demolishing a structure, the metal debris adds up fast. We can do one-time pickups or set up a recurring schedule for ongoing projects. Our crew loads everything — you don't need to stage it or sort it. We separate ferrous from non-ferrous at the recycling facility. For larger projects that also involve general construction debris, we can handle the full cleanout.

Frequently Asked Questions

What types of scrap metal do you pick up?

We take steel, iron, aluminum, copper, brass, and mixed metals. That includes old appliances, car parts, pipes, fencing, shelving, bed frames, grills, and just about any other metal item you want gone.

Do I get paid for my scrap metal?

Our service is junk removal, not scrap buying. The scrap value of your metal helps offset disposal costs, which keeps your removal price lower. For large quantities of clean, sorted metal, the scrap value may reduce your cost significantly.

Can you pick up a car or vehicle for scrap?

We don't handle whole vehicles, but we do pick up car parts — engines, transmissions, body panels, rims, and other automotive metal. For whole vehicle removal, we can point you to a local service.

Do you pick up scrap metal from job sites?

Yes. We work with contractors and property managers who need metal debris cleared from construction sites, renovation projects, and demolition jobs. We can schedule regular pickups or one-time cleanouts.
